about: llama.cpp's results on the same machine and prompts, for comparison, in artlite.json's schema: MiniCPM-V 4.7's image prompts (image_ttft_s) with the same GGUF files as Artlite's.
machine: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo, Radeon 8060S iGPU), Mesa 26.2.4 (RADV)

method.image_ttft_s: llama-server -c 32768 -np 1 -ngl 99 --mmproj FILE: an image prompt as Artlite's (artlite.json: image_prompts), cache_prompt false, 16 tokens: the client's time to the first token, median of 3 after a warmup; the best of 3 sessions (the iGPU's sessions differ by up to 8%)
